description: This Java source file defines the class SigfoxProtocolAdapterProperties, which extends HttpProtocolAdapterProperties and provides enhanced configuration properties specifically for Sigfox protocol adapters, including custom timeout settings.

classes.name: SigfoxProtocolAdapterProperties
classes.description: A class that extends HttpProtocolAdapterProperties to add Sigfox-specific configuration options, such as the timeout when acknowledgment is required.

methods.name: setTtdWhenAckRequired
methods.description: Sets a custom timeout value used when an acknowledgment is required, ensuring the value is not negative.

methods.name: getTtdWhenAckRequired
methods.description: Returns the current timeout value used when acknowledgment is required.
